scope: Four public POST entry points with current original-field and independent-finance access, idempotency, audit and documented contracts
checks: Original observations older than the registered bank return cannot create an intent; explicit original-id queries make actual observations current
Original refresh never resends bank or voucher commands, rejects changed displayed originals and is blocked by an active partial adjustment
Applicant, unrelated user, original cashier and hidden-field manager/admin cannot write; revoked finance also cannot replay an old idempotent success
Create accepts only exact remaining line amounts and distinct whole unused registered returns; tenant, actor, source, target, completion and line currency injection are rejected
Concurrent creates serialize under the report lock and save one active intent without sending financial commands
Actual completed net amounts and used returns form the successor; historical review and changed completed versions block creation
Each side is independently prepared and explicitly authorized via HTTP handlers; accepted original facts and completed peer operations remain unchanged
Zero-payable original refresh queries only accounting and creates no bank transaction
Authorization audit insertion failure rolls back preparation consumption, root revision, command, adjacent proof and idempotency claim; the original key can then execute once
Response contains identifiers and versions only, with no complete command, account or destination digest
